open_function_group.name: Axis servo system unspecified
open_function_group.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member marked23 reports receiving a Grizzly G1006 mill/drill with a CNC kit built by its previous owner. That earlier owner had converted the mill and built its servo-control and pendant boxes. The inherited system had used a Windows computer, Mach3, a parallel port, PMDX-122, and three Geckodrive G320 drives. marked23 got it moving, then began converting its computer/controller side to LinuxCNC, planning a Mesa 7i96S in place of the PMDX-122 and a USB game controller in place of the pendant. The owner intended to retain the original servo box and bespoke power supply. The inspected thread does not report completion of the LinuxCNC conversion.
